name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle, designed to travel on no more than three wheels, excluding motorized bicycles and electric-assisted bicycles; an electric one with a motor over 5 horsepower (3,750 W) is a full motorcycle rather than a motor-driven cycle. Defined by Louisiana Revised Statutes §32:1(51).

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground; excludes motorized bicycles and electric-assisted bicycles
Its motor exceeds 5 horsepower (3,750 W); one at or below that is a motor-driven cycle
Riders need a motorcycle (M) endorsement on a Louisiana driver's license or learner's permit, earned with knowledge and skills tests or a state motorcycle safety course
Every rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle safety helmet secured with a chin strap
Riders must wear approved eye protection unless it has a windshield tall enough to protect their eyes
Titled, registered and plated with the Office of Motor Vehicles, with liability insurance
Passengers only on a seat designed for one, and no child young enough to need a child safety seat
Entitled to a full lane; no lane splitting, and no more than two abreast in a lane
